verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms BugSnag SDKs capture and report exceptions (Bugsnag.notify()) and that captured events include user/device/session identifiers used to correlate related events, implying some contextual data is attached. However, there is no explicit documentation in the pack of breadcrumb APIs, custom tag/metadata attachment, or a dedicated user-context API. Missing for 10: explicit breadcrumb trail docs, custom tags/metadata API reference, dedicated setUser/user-context API documentation, and independent confirmation of these SDK features.
